slots.jd.design-build.about:
About us and the job
Quarry Hill Design-Build is an owner-run design-build firm in Nashville. We design and build our projects under one contract, and we stay close to the work. As Construction Manager, you will spend most of your time on site, leading our project teams, meeting with owners and keeping jobs safe, on budget and on schedule. The role is hybrid, with office days in Nashville.
slots.jd.design-build.duties:
What the job involves
- Run regular owner meetings and report progress, cost and risks in plain terms.
- Manage our project managers and superintendents, setting priorities and checking work on site.
- Price change orders and review them with owners before work proceeds.
- Keep schedules and budgets current across active projects.
- Walk sites with superintendents to check safety, quality and progress.
slots.jd.design-build.needs:
What you need
- 11 or more years of construction project management experience.
- Working knowledge of Oracle Primavera and Microsoft Project for scheduling.
- Experience with permit management and reading models in Autodesk Revit.
- Solid subcontractor coordination and contract administration skills.
- Construction Safety Manager Certificate required.
slots.r1.b1: Lead project managers and superintendents across active jobs, using Oracle Primavera to set look-ahead schedules and cutting schedule slippage by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Conduct site safety walks with superintendents and apply safety planning to correct hazards before crews start work.
slots.r1.b3: Present model views from Autodesk Revit in owner meetings, reducing design questions raised after meetings by 10 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Price change orders against the baseline schedule in Microsoft Project so owners see cost and time impact before approval.
slots.r1.b5: Review subcontractor submittals and maintain submittal tracking logs, shortening average approval turnaround by 15 percent.

slots.r1.i2: Tracks budgets and schedules across Juniper Row projects and reports cost and progress to company leadership.
slots.r2.b1: Negotiated contracts with owners and applied permit management to set realistic approval timelines, reducing permit-related delays by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Coordinated subcontractors through marked-up drawings in Bluebeam Revu, resolving field conflicts before installation.
slots.r2.b3: Scheduled permits and inspections alongside punch list closeout, shortening the time from substantial completion to final inspection by 30 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Tracked project budgets and schedules in Oracle Primavera and flagged cost or time variances to owners early.
slots.r2.b5: Supervised project managers and superintendents on safety planning, lowering recordable incidents by 10 percent.
slots.r2.i1: Tracked budgets and schedules for Marlow Contracting projects as Senior Project Manager, reporting variances to owners and company leadership.
slots.r2.i2: Managed project managers and superintendents at Marlow Contracting, setting priorities and reviewing progress across concurrent jobs.
slots.r3.b1: Reviewed submittals against Autodesk Revit models, cutting resubmittals by 35 percent.

slots.r3.b4: Tracked budgets and schedules and handled permit management so approval dates were reflected in cost and time forecasts.
slots.r3.b5: Led site safety walks and recorded findings in Bluebeam Revu, reducing open safety items by 20 percent.
